violations.text: Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of PIC, hashbrowns were placed hot and covered in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Hashrbowsn were transferred to sheet pans at the time of inspection. Proper cooling methods reviewed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The chest cooler gasket was observed in poor repair. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026
The grout in the ice machine area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
